about: US Census 2020 P.L. 94-171 block population (POP100) and housing units (HU100) for blocks intersecting the StormSim tile; rings in local m from grid SW, simplified 2 m. Used to calibrate residents per building (block population split over residential floor area).
source: US Census Bureau TIGERweb tigerWMS_Census2020 MapServer layer 10 (Census Blocks), fields POP100/HU100, https://tigerweb.geo.census.gov/arcgis/rest/services/TIGERweb/tigerWMS_Census2020/MapServer/10
